blocks.orig: Chumbe Island is an award-winning private nature reserve just outside the west coast of Zanzibar. The island has an eco-lodge, some historical monuments, a fully protected coral reef sanctuary, and a forest reserve. During this full-day visit, you go snorkelling over one of the most diverse coral reefs of East Africa, take a guided walk through the forest, climb the historical lighthouse and get a tour of an eco-bungalow. A fresh lunch and boat transport are of course included!
blocks.html: Just off the west coast of Zanzibar lies Chumbe Island, an award-winning private nature reserve. On the island you find an eco-lodge, a few historical monuments, a coral reef sanctuary under full protection and a forest reserve. On this full-day trip you snorkel over one of the most varied coral reefs in East Africa, join a guided forest walk, climb the historical lighthouse and are shown around an eco-bungalow. Naturally, a fresh lunch and the boat transfers are included!
